user.title: Find a stop
user.description: Type part of the stop name, or leave the field empty to list stops near your home.

stop.title: Choose the stop
stop.description: Stops usually come in pairs, one per direction. The direction is in the name.

pair.title: Fallback source
pair.description: The same stop on livetransport.eu, used when varnatraffic.com is down. The ✓ marks the exact match found by stop code for {stop}. Choose — to use varnatraffic only.

error.cannot_connect: varnatraffic.com did not answer. Try again in a moment.
error.livetransport_unreachable: livetransport.eu did not answer, so no fallback can be paired now. You can continue without it.

data_description.lines: Comma separated, e.g. 9, 109, 14a. Empty shows all lines.
data_description.line_names: For varnatraffic ids it does not list itself, e.g. 219=209б.
